disclosure: Synthetic scenarios. Every decision, ranking and score on this page was computed by the engine when the site was built, at the evaluation time shown; nothing runs while you browse. Synthetic results test software behavior and are not evidence of data quality, model quality or market performance. The release preview is not an approval and nothing is activated.

scenarios.title: TV viewing in a clean room
scenarios.summary: A buyer wants act-alike households exported as a score file. The clean room permits internal scoring and qualifying aggregates, and prohibits row-level export.

scenarios.title: Web events look-alike
scenarios.summary: A buyer wants browsers that resemble a seed list. The same data is also asked for a new propensity model and a bring-your-own remote look-alike model.

scenarios.title: Pages for a content brief
scenarios.summary: A buyer wants pages that match a quick-dinner content brief. The available vectors are taxonomy pseudo-vectors without alignment evidence.

scenarios.title: A new source in quarantine
scenarios.summary: A new vendor feed arrives before a steward has confirmed what its keys mean. It can be profiled safely; it cannot be scored yet.
